title: FlowDoc Documentation Authority Cleanup
summary: Centralize FlowDoc-wide documentation authority in Project Control, then classify and clean repository-local Markdown without losing source evidence or repo-owned contracts.
expectedOutput: Project Control commit 98bcec99d905c95feb765c1d630bda2f225bd998 adds the Project Control documentation authority policy and cleanup Work foundation that requires Authority Boundary wording before product-repository Markdown cleanup starts. Editor commit 04daeeaaac04317508b5cf8e93de61249255d477 retires the old node-authoring roadmap plan/spec pair from docs/superpowers and guards surviving docs/superpowers files with temporary Authority Boundary wording. Evidence target evidence-editor-node-authoring-roadmap-docs-retired-2026-08-31 records the first product-repository cleanup slice as work-scoped evidence only.
riskSummary: Repo-local Markdown is not deleted by this foundation phase, and Core, Backend, and Editor still contain many Markdown files that need separate classification, source preservation, and repository-owned cleanup verification before removal. Editor WYSIWYG and Overview/History docs/superpowers files remain intentionally because current tests and Project Control evidence still reference them; they now carry or already carried Authority Boundary wording until later migration or retirement. Editor npm ci still reports 5 high severity audit findings and Vite still reports the existing chunk-size warning. The cleanup worktree folder C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-doc-retire-0831 remains on disk after git worktree remove reported Filename too long; Git no longer lists it as a worktree, branch fd-ed-doc-roadmap-retire-0831 was deleted, and direct recursive deletion was intentionally avoided because node_modules contains junctions into Core.
